N001政→正 S-intro only; REJECT as reading-negative: 正 «правильный; верный» is not a supported current meaning answer for 政 «политика; управление»; historical correction does not make them synonyms. Shared 正 and exact セイ/ショウ make visual comparison useful but the reading foil unsafe.
N002政→教 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: shared 攵, different left sides. 教 «обучать; наставлять», including instruction/faith senses, does not supply governing 政's meaning. All-mode approval withheld.
N003政→敗 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: intra-batch shared 攵, 正 versus 貝. 敗 «неудача; поражение», including spoilage/failure, is not a meaning of 政. No reverse inference.
N004敗→買 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: shared 貝, but 買 «покупать» is not defeat, failure or spoilage. バイ versus ハイ is similarity, not identical reading; no blanket phonetic approval.
N005敗→員 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: compare 貝 under 口 with 貝 beside 攵. 員 «член группы; сотрудник» does not answer 敗; 員's additional number sense does not alter this direction.
N006敗→数 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: intra-batch shared 攵. 数 «число; количество» is not a meaning of 敗. A counter for losses does not itself mean 'number/quantity'.
N007数→料 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: shared 米, differing 女/攵 versus 斗 arrangement. 料 «материалы; плата» does not match 数, including fate, stratagem and repeatedness. Archaic 料 'adornment' establishes no collision.
N008数→教 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: shared 攵 does not turn 数 into 教 «обучать; наставлять». Mathematics being taught is an association, not a meaning.
N009数→政 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: intra-batch shared 攵. 政 «политика; управление» is not supported for 数; 'law' or 'stratagem' does not by itself establish equivalence to government.
N010散→政 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: intra-batch shared 攵. 政 «политика; управление» does not match scattering, wandering, idleness or medicinal-powder senses of 散.
N011散→教 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: shared 攵, distinct left forms. 教 «обучать; наставлять» is not supported for 散; radical membership implies no semantic equality.
N012散→期 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: intra-batch 月-like parts/horizontal strokes justify visual contrast, not identical structure. 期 «период; срок» does not answer 散, including secondary senses.
N013期→朝 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: shared right 月. 朝 «утро» is not a meaning of 期. 朝's secondary 'period/epoch' concerns the reverse direction; neither time-domain proximity nor midnight ご makes 'morning' correct.
N014期→服 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: 月 changes position. 服 «одежда» is not a meaning of 期. Archaic 服 'period of mourning' concerns the reverse direction, not clothing as an answer here.
N015期→明 S-intro; bounded meaning-negative supported: shared right 月, 其 versus 日. 明 «светлый; ясный» is not a meaning of 期; 明's coming-date use does not change that.
L001政 SUPPORTED within lesson scope: Political activity/body distinction, source readings, attribution and mnemonic are coherent; 政所 illustrates まん without an exclusivity claim.
L002敗 SUPPORTED within lesson scope: Failure, defeat, spoilage, attributed 貝 sound role and loss counter are distinguished; title ordering is acceptable.
L003数 PARTIALLY SUPPORTED: Facts/meanings are supported, but '数学 linked(existing)' is false in the current lesson. See F1.
L004散 SUPPORTED within lesson scope: Attributed 肉/月 plus modified 㪔 account and サ origin match the capture; modern shape observation is not substituted for history.
L005期 SUPPORTED within text-evidence scope: 其 sound role, lunar-cycle account, expectation sense, ゴ examples and month-length warning are supported; the unseen meaning-component image was not inspected.
A001 SUPPORTED: JMdict 1375890 marks formal/literary usage; 1375970/1376070 support the bounded 政治/政府 distinction; KanjiPedia lists 政所.
A002 SUPPORTED: 1901390 gives noun/loss counter; 1320140/1472510/1497980 support comparisons. しっぱい is attested, not しつはい; no exclusive opponent requirement is imposed on every 敗れる use.
A003 SUPPORTED: 1580825 establishes prefix 'several'; 1005580 marks しばしば usually kana. 人の数 differs from a written digit without denying the separate numeral sense of 数（すう）.
A004 SUPPORTED: 1303490/1303460 support transitivity and verb-stem suffix; 1924560 supports loose goods/usual kana; 散歩 is taught lexically.
A005 SUPPORTED: 1220540/2842959 support suffix/ご senses; がっき is attested, not がくき; 月 does not impose month-long duration.

NAV02 words/政治.md: NAV-ONLY; one standalone 政 wrapper to ../kanji/政.md; no semantic/metadata change; LF.

Additional pool titles 局 «управление; отделение» and 御 «почтительный префикс; управлять» warrant contextual fallback scrutiny, not automatic guards. O002 ACCEPT as flags: 勝 opposition, 失 failure/loss connection, 成 contrast and weak 売 sound similarity are distinct relations. O003 ACCEPT as flags: 計 counting/measuring proximity deserves scrutiny; 字/学/回 compound membership alone proves no guard. O004 ACCEPT as flags: 集 is an antonym, 歩 a lexical partner, 参/山/三 share サン; none implies a new negative edge. O005 ACCEPT as flags: 時 «время; час» and 間 «промежуток; между» can overlap 期's time/interval sense and cannot be presumed safe fallback foils; 月/学/待/起/気 need separate directional/contextual decisions.

Fix the row to [数学](../words/数学.md) (すうがく), link its substantive word-list occurrence consistently, and correct L003's linked claim to match the resulting bytes. Evidence: complete current 数/数学 bodies, guidance on substantive links/linked reading examples, complete L003. Confidence HIGH. No Japanese rewrite or new page is needed.
